title: He Built the iPhone, Now Apple's Coming for Him
description:
Apple is suing Tang Tan, a 24-year veteran who helped design the iPhone and Apple Watch, in a new trade secret and trademark case. Before leaving, he emailed himself supplier data and confidential files, then co-founded io with Jony Ive, which OpenAI bought for $6.5 billion in pre-IPO shares with no product yet. Here's the full story behind the Apple vs OpenAI lawsuit and the great unbundling of Apple.



Get the court filing (Apple v. Liu) here: https://www.courtlistener.com/docket/73602437/apple-inc-v-liu/



#Apple #OpenAI #JonyIve #TechNews #AInews #Lawsuit
